sources.note: Main website. Describes NovoClinical as integrated EMR/practice management/billing system. Lists core modules: EHR, billing, RCM, CCM, telemedicine, patient portal, auto check-in, API/HL7 integrations. Cloud-based, tablet-compatible.
Mandatory disclosures page. Describes NovoClinical as certified EHR for small business billing. Lists same core features. Links to API terms, application access specifications.

Features page. Describes 360 practice-driven solution with EHR, patient portal, telemedicine, auto check-in, billing, RCM, CCM, cloud infrastructure, API/HL7 integrations, tablet support, MU certification.
About page. Company based in Ogden, UT. Nearly 20 years of R&D. Proprietary modular design. Paper-chart-familiar interface. Claims to reduce overhead to 5% or less.

Third-party EMR listing. Details features: scheduling, charting, decision support, e-prescribing, order tracking, patient eligibility, e-fax, texting, coding, billing, accounting, credit card integration. Supports general practice, cardiology, immunology, gastroenterology, OB/GYN, pediatrics. RIS/PACS integration, ICD-10 support.

Third-party listing. Cloud-based ONC-certified EHR/PM. Pricing: $99-$385/provider/month in three tiers. Voice recognition, lab integration, telemedicine, CCM. Free patient portal. 2015 ONC HIT certification received April 2018.

Third-party review site. 30 reviews, 85% excellent. Practice management includes scheduling, check-ins, referrals, reporting. RCM from registration through payment collection. CCM for diabetes, hypertension, heart disease. Notes vendor has not specified third-party integration details.

Third-party listing. Confirms EHR+PM combo with e-prescribing, device integration, UB-04 billing, claim scrubbing, DME billing. RIS/PACS integration. Supports Mac OS, Windows, web browsers. Multiple specialties.
ZoomInfo listing (not fetched, from search results). NovoClinical Inc employs 5-9 people. Located in Ogden, UT.
ZoomInfo listing (not fetched, from search results). NovoMedici has 9 employees.
